Subject: variant_id=WAS-p.Thr45Met gene=WAS accession=P42768 position=45 reference=T alternate=M

Task: Favoured hypothesis after the decision is H2 (stability_folding, agent-generated hypothesis: core destabilisation; T1 FoldX ddG +3.56 kcal/mol predicted destabilising; T2 residue 45 in buried predicted pockets). Find what a drug could act on for this mechanism and which molecules already do it, then propose them. Write one target_rationale with the direction of effect, and a candidates_proposed note with each row's bridge kind and direction check (matches, opposes or unknown). Do not type any molecule name yourself; molecules enter only by tool-returned candidate_ref. Research only: no treatment or dosing wording. Then handoff.

For H2 the direction would be to restore folded, active WASP, since the variant lowers the folded fraction. The catalogue has not confirmed this direction, so it is a hypothesis only.", "why": "H2 (stability_folding) is the favoured mechanism after decision seq 55 and was kept at seq 77.
